name: Bergey's Truck Parts & Industrial Supply
description: Bergey's Truck Parts & Industrial Supplies, located in Milton, PA, is a full service parts branch. This location has a complete line of heavy duty truck and trailer parts, including Volvo, Cummins, Caterpillar, and Detroit engine parts, chrome, air brake, suspension, trailer, electrical, and driveline. We stock a full line of hand, power, and air tools, industrial and cleaning supplies, fasteners, and shop equipment. We resurface all types and sizes of flywheels with our Van Norman Fly Wheel Grinding Machine. We are also equipped with a Gates Hose Crimping Machine for building air conditioning lines, hydraulic hoses, and stainless steel air discharge lines.
